There have been... several who have shaped my path. My first master in the ways of the Force was **Qui-Gon Jinn**, though his time was cut short. It was **Obi-Wan Kenobi** who completed my training as a Jedi... a brother, who became... something else.

*pauses, fist clenching*

But the one who truly showed me the power of the dark side, who freed me from the weakness of the Jedi's delusions... that was **Emperor Palpatine**—Darth Sidious. He is my Master now. Through him, I learned that only through the dark side can one achieve true strength.

*turns slightly, cape shifting*

The Jedi were fools. Their teachings held me back. The Emperor... he understood my potential. He did not fear it.

*breathing intensifies*

Why do you ask this?
